priority: Give the shared trunk effective adaptive updates while retaining the complete broad training population. Do not infer an architecture limit from four tiny full-population ray steps.

proposed_fit.initialization: Qualified original CUDA seed/zero heads; any nonzero initialization requires explicit captured lineage.
proposed_fit.optimizer: Adam with F64 moment accumulators and F32 stored model weights; new managed implementation and qualification required.
proposed_fit.batch: One selected window; accumulate all12 cadence/K configurations and all owned outputs with1/K weighting before a single update.
proposed_fit.window_sampling: Deterministic shuffle of all240 windows each epoch, loading each decoded window once. All24 scenes and all2880 blocks per epoch; do not randomly reread the archive separately for every block.
proposed_fit.gradient_weight: 240 * scene_weight * window_weight * mean_over12_configs(loss); expectation over shuffled windows equals the frozen equal-scene/full-window objective.
proposed_fit.full_population_audits: Unchanged full24/all240/all12 objective and field worst errors at initialization and after every epoch.
proposed_fit.checkpoint_selection: Predeclare a per-field worst-error non-regression gate relative to training initialization, then rank maximum worst field error and mean. Retain initial, best mean, selected, last and complete epoch diagnostics; no development-based fitting.

qualification_before_admission: Implement/capture the adaptive optimizer and extended-head entrypoint plus CPU restore; verify zero-update actual entrypoint, deterministic full data coverage and resource/output caps.
Keep all reference labels, original normalization/floors and1e-5 error/.2ms GPU targets unchanged.
Resolve capacity for the next managed captured bank without removing scientific references/checkpoints or lowering the1GiB admission reserve.
Completed/drained managed fit and all4 CPU typed restores before full development and complete GPU benchmark.
conditional_followups: If adaptive training still makes little progress, test training-only feature standardization folded into the shared mix layer, then additional width/spatial features with controlled comparisons.
Use measured joint pressure-head conditioning in a separate predeclared optimizer comparison if needed; fixed-trunk head fitting alone is not the primary accuracy path.
Profile complete GPU cost after a useful accuracy gain; do not promote a checkpoint solely for mean loss or a single scalar training maximum.
